FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How often should I book maintenance cleaning?
Most households choose between weekly and monthly visits depending on use and preference.
Can I prioritise certain rooms?
Yes. You can specify priorities in the inquiry so teams focus where it matters most.
Do you bring cleaning products?
We can bring professional supplies or use your products on request — please tell us beforehand.
Can appointment times be adjusted?
Yes. We offer flexible windows and will coordinate times that work for you.
